note: Hand-digitised extents, traced in QGIS over a georeferenced source map (EPSG:4326). Each feature needs properties.place_id (e.g. CZ-011) and properties.source (which map it was traced from, e.g. 'ICC 1909 map'). A polygon may only ever be traced from a source - never sketched from intuition. Where a place has no polygon here, the map falls back to its honest circle/glyph rendering.
